Introduction

VANNER is a five-member South Korean boy group formed by VT Entertainment, consisting of Taehwan, Gon, Hyesung, Sungkook, and Yeonggwang. Although they officially debuted in Korea on February 14, 2019, with the studio album "V", they had already begun promotions in Japan in 2018. Their name combines "Victory" and "Banner," symbolizing their ambition to rise to the top.

In 2023, VANNER gained wider recognition after winning JTBC's survival show Peak Time, which concluded on April 19. Following their win, they signed a three-year contract with KLAP Entertainment on May 4, 2023. On April 26, 2025, it was announced that VANNER’s contracts with KLAP Entertainment would end on May 31, 2025.

On May 23, 2025, VANNER leader Taehwan revealed that KLAP Entertainment had transferred the group’s trademark rights directly to the members. However, on May 31, the group officially parted ways with both their original agency, VT Entertainment, and their subsequent management under KLAP Entertainment. In a heartfelt message to fans on August 22 via the official fan café, Taehwan announced that the members had decided to pursue individual paths for the time being, citing circumstances that made it difficult for all five to continue as one. He emphasized that while this decision was not easy and may be disappointing to fans, the members remain supportive of one another and hope to reunite in the future if the opportunity arises. Taehwan expressed his gratitude and love for VVS, apologizing for the delay in sharing the news and promising to work hard toward returning to the stage someday. Currently, member Sungkook is serving his mandatory military enlistment, and Yeonggwang is scheduled to enlist on September 4, 2025.
